title: Otacoustic
summary: OTACOUS'TIC, adjective [Gr. ears, and to hear.] Assisting the sense of hearing; as an otacoustic instrument. OTACOUS'TIC, noun An instrument to facilitate hearing.

inlines.v: OTACOUS'TIC, adjective [Gr. ears, and to hear.] Assisting the sense of hearing; as an otacoustic instrument. OTACOUS'TIC, noun An instrument to facilitate hearing.
